verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe rolling production back to a previous deployment, without a rebuild, for fast incident recovery. A rollback path is also part of rolling releases, and a 'Deployment Rollback' webhook event confirms rollback is a first-class platform action. missing for 10: explicit evidence that rollback is a one-click action, explicit confirmation that any (not just the immediately previous) deployment can be targeted, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click

citations.quote: Roll back to a previous deployment for swift recovery from production incidents.
Revert production to a previous deployment without a rebuild when something breaks.
Send a new deployment to a percentage of traffic first, then promote it or roll back.
